task: Make the indexed MossString record the native String representation for L7 finding 2.
observation: Every generated Moss crate embeds its own copy of the Rust runtime prelude. With MossStr = String this was invisible because String is a std type, but with MossStr = MossString a provider's MossString and a consumer's are distinct Rust types, and a two-package build failed in rustc with 'expected moss_net::MossString, found MossString'.
impact: A runtime-defined value type cannot cross Moss crates without one compiler-owned runtime crate linked by every provider and consumer, the same placement Team G's G0 prototype uses for MossMap<K,V>. The indexed String was therefore staged for single-crate builds, with multi-crate staged builds failing closed, instead of inventing a second shared-crate mechanism.
evidence: MOSS_STAGED_STRING_REPR=indexed-v1 ./margo run on a two-package app (net + app) -> rustc E0308/E0053

resolution.summary: Staged single-crate representation with fail-closed multi-crate builds; shared runtime crate raised as a joint ABI-v10 coordination item.
